events.text: Edward the Elder gave the land then known as Weolingtun to Bishop Asser.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In a grant of between 899 and 909 Edward the Elder gave the land then known as Weolingtun

events.text: The name had changed to Walintone by the time of the Domesday Book of 1082.
events.subject: self
events.quote: By the time of the Domesday Book of 1082 , the name had changed to Walintone

events.text: A royal charter of 1215 gave Wellington its status as a town.
events.subject: self
events.quote: A royal charter of 1215 gave Wellington its status as a town

events.text: The manor was sold to Edward Seymour, 1st Duke of Somerset.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1548 , the manor was sold to Edward Seymour , 1st Duke of Somerset

events.text: Major rebuilding took place in the town following a fire.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Major rebuilding took place in the town following a fire in 1731

events.text: Arthur Wellesley took the title of his Marquessate in 1809 from this town of Wellington.
events.subject: other

events.text: The foundation stone of the Wellington Monument was laid.

events.subject: self
events.quote: the monument was not completed until 1854
